about: Looks as words: a style line that opens every prompt of a film, plus optional lens and light phrases. All positive wording: H3 has no negative prompt. General looks only; no named films, shows, games or living artists.

styles.name: Cinematic realism
styles.text: The video is in realistic photographic cinematic style: natural colours, soft contrast, shallow depth of field, fine film grain.

styles.name: Action movie
styles.text: The video is in realistic photographic cinematic action-movie style: punchy contrast, teal and amber grade, crisp detail, slight haze.

styles.name: Neon night
styles.text: The video is in realistic photographic cinematic style, a gritty futuristic city look at night: wet surfaces, neon reflections, teal, magenta and amber light, slight haze.

styles.name: Golden hour
styles.text: The video is in realistic photographic cinematic style at golden hour: low warm sunlight, long soft shadows, glowing rim light on hair and shoulders.

styles.name: Film noir
styles.text: The video is in black-and-white film noir style: hard single-source light, deep shadows, venetian-blind patterns, cigarette haze, fine grain.

styles.name: Documentary
styles.text: The video looks like an observational documentary: natural available light, handheld camera, true colours, real textures.

styles.name: Commercial gloss
styles.text: The video is in polished commercial style: clean bright studio lighting, glossy reflections, saturated product colours, crisp focus.

styles.name: 1990s sitcom
styles.text: The video looks like a 1990s American multi-camera sitcom shot on 35mm film: warm even studio lighting, soft pastel set, gentle grain.

styles.name: Home video tape
styles.text: The video looks like a 1990s home video tape: soft low resolution, colour bleed, slight tracking noise, a date stamp glow, handheld.

styles.name: Super 8
styles.text: The video looks like Super 8 film: warm faded colours, heavy grain, light leaks, slight gate weave.

styles.name: Music video
styles.text: The video is in bold music-video style: saturated coloured lights, haze, lens flares, strong backlight and silhouettes.

styles.name: Horror
styles.text: The video is in realistic photographic horror style: cold desaturated colours, dim practical lights, deep black shadows, slow uneasy stillness.

styles.name: Western
styles.text: The video is in classic western style: harsh midday sun, dusty air, sun-bleached wood, wide open landscape, warm earthy grade.

styles.name: Pastel storybook
styles.text: The video is in a symmetrical pastel storybook style: centred compositions, flat frontal framing, soft candy colours, tidy miniature-like sets.

styles.name: Hand-drawn animation
styles.text: The video is hand-drawn 2D cel animation: clean ink outlines, flat shaded colours, painted backgrounds, expressive poses.

styles.name: Stop-motion clay
styles.text: The video is stop-motion clay animation: sculpted clay figures with visible fingerprints, miniature sets, slightly stepped movement.

styles.name: Fashion film
styles.text: The video is in high-fashion editorial style: clean seamless backdrop or runway, sculpted light, crisp fabric detail, confident poses.

styles.name: Phone selfie video
styles.text: The video looks like a casual vertical phone selfie video: natural indoor light, slight handheld movement, direct and unpolished.
